name: Deformable Radial Kernel (DRK)
definition: A novel 3D scene representation primitive that uses radial basis functions with varying lengths and polar angles to define kernel shape, addressing the overparameterization and geometric fidelity limitations of Gaussian distributions.
summary: Deformable Radial Kernel replaces fixed Gaussian symmetry with flexible planar kernels, enabling sharp edges and adaptive stretching for high-fidelity rendering with fewer primitives.
